THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, MONDAY, OCTOBER 7, 1935

RADIO CONGESTION
Registration as Remedy

To the Editor of the
"NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS"
Sir, —Compulsory registration of radio receiving sets, threats of fines for non-registration of same, and arbitrary grouping of broadcasting stations will not solve the deplorable local radio situation.
There is only one remedy, and it is simplicity itself.
It simply consists of
(1) the recommendations recently made in your paper by no less an authority than Mr. Robert L. Stewart, General Manager of the American Radio Equipment Co., 265 7 Avenue Haig, for replacing the antiquated and wholly inefficient apparatus used by most stations with up-to-the-minute equipment of proven worth and usefulness (which, by the way, is not so costly, as a cursory glance at the leading radio magazines carrying advertisements of radio receiving and sending instruments will reveal).
(2) the increase of transmission power. (It is interesting to remark in this connection that for the inaudible 1,000 watts used here, the formidable half a million watts or more is common in the United States).
Really, all this hullabaloo set up by the geniuses of the Chinese Radio Administration is not to improve the local broadcasting, but to get more revenue—both in fines and licenses. Why, then, beat about the bush with all this ridiculous palaver about station grouping, since it would be like pleasing Paul and displeasing Harry all this senseless monopoly of the air for a certain favoured section of this city while the other section gets only blank silence or, at best, a few meaningless buzzings?
RADIO FAN.
Shanghai, Oct. 4.

File
H.S.
6 OCT. 1935

《字林西报》，1935年10月7日，星期一

无线电拥堵
以登记为补救措施

致《字林西报》编辑先生：

对无线电接收机实行强制登记、对未登记者威胁处以罚款，以及任意划分广播电台组别，并不能解决本地令人痛心的无线电状况。
只有一种补救办法，而且极其简单。
它仅仅包括：
(1) 海格路（Haig Avenue）265号美国无线电设备公司（American Radio Equipment Co.）总经理罗伯特·L·斯图尔特（Robert L. Stewart）先生——一位极具权威的人士——最近在贵报提出的建议，即用经过验证具有价值和效用的最新设备，取代大多数电台使用的陈旧且完全低效的设备（顺便提一句，只要粗略浏览一下刊登无线电收发仪器广告的主要无线电杂志，就会发现这些设备并不那么昂贵）。
(2) 增加发射功率。（在此值得一提的是，这里使用的1,000瓦功率导致声音微弱，而在美国，常见的则是高达50万瓦或更多的强大功率）。
实际上，中国无线电管理局的那些“天才”们搞出的所有这些喧闹，并不是为了改善本地广播，而是为了获取更多收入——无论是通过罚款还是许可证费。那么，既然这种毫无意义的垄断空气的行为只是为了取悦本市某些受优待的区域，而其他区域只能听到一片死寂，或者至多是一些无意义的嗡嗡声，这就像是为了讨好保罗而得罪哈里一样，何必还要用关于电台分组的所有这些荒谬废话来兜圈子呢？

无线电爱好者
上海，10月4日。

存档
H.S.
1935年10月6日

October 1, 1935. Morning Translation.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers :-

THE REGISTRATION OF RADIOS

Acting on an order received from the
Ministry of Communications, the International Telegraph
Administration some time ago issued a circular notice
to the effect that all owners of radio receiving sets
should apply for registration with the Administration
before the end of September.
Many Chinese and foreign residents have
applied for registration and over 68,000 radio
receiving sets had been registered. After investigating
the applications received, the Administration has
requested the Ministry of Communications to issue the
certificates.
The period for registration expired
yesterday. A fine of between $5 and $200 will be
imposed on anyone who has failed to register his radio
receiving set.
The Administration has issued the following
circular notice :-
"This Administration has received confidential
reports to the effect that certain persons, impersonating
representatives of this Administration, have attempted
to extort money from owners of radio receiving sets.
Up to the present, this Administration has not sent any
member to inspect radio receiving sets and when this
Administration eventually does detail men to make an
inspection, he will be furnished with a certificate of
identification. This notice is hereby issued for the
information of the public."

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers :-

CONSTRUCTION OF NEW GAOLS IN CHINA

Since January 1, 1935, the Ministry of Justice
has constructed nine gaols in the various provinces and 14
others are still under construction. The Ministry has
also constructed eight new detention houses in Shanghai
and other cities.
In order to relieve the congestion of
prisoners in the 1st and 2nd Special District Court
gaols in Shanghai, the Ministry of Justice has purchased
170 mow of land in Poo Soong District (蒲淞區),
Shanghai, on which a gaol which can accommodate over
8,000 prisoners will be constructed. When the new gaol
is ready, prisoners from the 2nd Kiangsu Gaol, the 2nd
Special District Gaol and the Ward Road Gaol will be
transferred to the new institution. These three
gaols will then be converted into detention houses for
remand prisoners.

《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：

无线电登记

国际电报局此前奉交通部命令发布通令，大意是所有无线电接收机所有者应在九月底前向该局申请登记。
许多中外居民已申请登记，已有超过68,000台无线电接收机完成登记。在审查收到的申请后，该局已请求交通部颁发证书。
登记期于昨日届满。任何未能登记其无线电接收机的人将被处以5至200美元的罚款。
该局发布了以下通令：
“本局收到密报，称有人冒充本局代表，试图向无线电接收机所有者勒索钱财。截至目前，本局未派遣任何人员检查无线电接收机，当本局最终指派人员进行检查时，他们将出示身份证明文件。特此发布公告，以告公众。”

《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：

中国新建监狱

自1935年1月1日以来，司法部已在各省建造了九所监狱，另有14所仍在建设中。该部还在上海和其他城市建造了八所新的拘留所。
为了缓解上海第一和第二特区法院监狱的囚犯拥挤状况，司法部在上海蒲淞区购买了170亩土地，将在该地建造一所可容纳8,000多名囚犯的监狱。新监狱建成后，来自江苏第二监狱、第二特区监狱和华德路监狱的囚犯将被转移到新机构。这三所监狱随后将改为关押候审囚犯的拘留所。

September 28, 1935. Morning Translation.

Shanghai Public Daily News(市民日报) of September 27 :-

THE REGISTRATION OF RADIOS.

In an interview with a reporter of this paper, an official of the International Telegraph Administration made the following statement:- "The Administration will issue certificates to the owners of radio receiving sets, who have applied for registration. The Administration will then detail experts to call on owners and inspect radio receiving sets. The reasons for this are as follows:- (1) To ascertain whether or not there is any possibility of danger from the antenna. (2) To ascertain whether sets have been installed to intercept wireless messages transmitted on a long or short wave length. (3) To advise owners how to avoid danger when using the sets. These officers will be provided with certificates".

Shanghai Morning Post published the following editorial on September 26 :-

THE CAUSES OF OUR POVERTY.

In its issue of September 20 our contemporary, the "Peiping Morning Post", publishes an editorial entitled "Why is our country so poor?" It says, in part:-
"During the past 40 years the island of Formosa has been considerably developed. Since its occupation by Japan, this island of unhealthy climate whose soil is almost uncultivable and unproductive has become a place of riches, richer than Kiangpeh. Had this island remained Chinese, it is probable that the Central Government would have to grant it a subsidy for its administrative expenses! Fukien is close to Formosa and possesses all the physical advantages of Formosa but without its disadvantages. Yet Formosa to-day is prosperous and has a revenue of Taels 120,000,000 per annum while Fukien is experiencing great difficulty in even finding the 30 to 40 million dollars for its administrative expenses. It is not only Fukien which finds itself in this deplorable condition, most of our provinces are in a similar plight. All this goes to show that our poverty is due to human faults, that this poverty is the consequence of a corrupt administration. Unless the necessary reforms are introduced into our administration and corrupt officials are severely punished, China will never be able to emerge from her state of poverty."
We also have for some time longed to express our views on this subject. Let us examine the causes of our poverty.
In our opinion, it is undeniable that the causes of our poverty are due to our corrupt officials. It is no exaggeration to say that most of our officials are corrupt. Let us examine some of our high officials, such as the Magistrates, the Chiefs of Departments, the Governors and the Ministers. Hardly have they been in office a few months, when these gentlemen or at least

9月27日《市民日报》：

无线电登记。

国际电报局一名官员在接受本报记者采访时发表如下声明：“该局将向已申请登记的无线电接收机所有者颁发证书。随后，该局将派遣专家走访所有者并检查无线电接收机。原因如下：(1) 确定天线是否存在任何危险可能性。(2) 确定设备安装是否用于截获长波或短波传输的无线电信号。(3) 建议所有者在使用设备时如何避免危险。这些官员将持有证明文件”。

9月26日《上海晨报》发表以下社论：

我们贫困的原因。

我们的同行《北平晨报》在9月20日的版面上发表了一篇题为“我国为何如此贫穷？”的社论。部分内容如下：
“在过去40年里，台湾岛得到了相当大的发展。自从被日本占领以来，这个气候不宜人、土壤几乎无法耕种且贫瘠的岛屿，已经变成了一个富裕之地，比江北还要富裕。如果这个岛屿仍属于中国，中央政府可能不得不为其行政开支提供补贴！福建靠近台湾，拥有台湾所有的地理优势，却没有其劣势。然而，今天的台湾繁荣发达，年收入达1.2亿两白银，而福建甚至连筹集3,000万至4,000万美元的行政经费都面临巨大困难。不仅福建处于这种可悲的境地，我国大多数省份也面临类似的困境。所有这些都表明，我们的贫困是由于人为的过失，这种贫困是腐败行政的后果。除非在我们的行政体系中引入必要的改革并严惩腐败官员，否则中国永远无法摆脱贫困状态。”
我们也渴望已久，想就此主题表达我们的观点。让我们审视一下我们贫困的原因。
在我们看来，不可否认，我们贫困的原因在于我们的腐败官员。说我们大多数官员都是腐败的，并非夸张。让我们审视一下我们的一些高官，如县长、局长、省长和部长。这些绅士们上任不过几个月，至少……

The Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury, Saturday, September 28, 1935
No. 6813
Date 30 9 35

U.S. Consulate
Rules On Radios

Americans Not Required
To Register Sets On
Nanking Order

With reference to the campaign
of the Chinese Bureau of Inter-
national Telegraphs for registration
of all radio sets, Mr. Edwin S.
Cunningham, American Consul-
General here, has told The Shang-
hai Evening Post that Americans
are not required to register their
sets.
"The regulations are not applic-
able and cannot be enforced against
Americans," Mr. Cunningham said.
"If Americans observe them, it will
be a voluntary act on their part
to which we do not object. It is
impossible to enforce any penal
clauses of the regulations against
Americans."
Under the regulations, fines
ranging from $10 to $200 are
scheduled to be imposed upon all
owners of radio sets who do not
register them. Registration is sup-
posed to be within the present
month.
Registration is free of charge
and its stated purpose is for com-
pilation of statistics by the bureau,
with a view to finding out in what
part of the city radio sets are
chiefly located. Following the in-
vestigation arrangements will be
made to remove the various radio
broadcasting and transmitting sta-
tions to suitable localities so as to
eliminate the prevailing garbled
transmission.

Reg.
Please attach
to file. JRS
30 SEP. 1935

第6813号
日期 1935年9月30日

美国领事馆
关于无线电的规定

美国人无需根据南京命令
登记无线电设备

针对中国国际电报局要求登记所有无线电设备的运动，驻沪美国总领事埃德温·S·坎宁安（Edwin S. Cunningham）先生告诉《上海晚邮报》，美国人无需登记他们的设备。
坎宁安先生说：“这些规定不适用，也不能对美国人强制执行。如果美国人遵守这些规定，那是他们自愿的行为，我们对此不反对。不可能对美国人执行该规定的任何处罚条款。”
根据规定，凡不登记无线电设备的所有者，将被处以10至200美元不等的罚款。登记预计在本月内完成。
登记免费，其 stated purpose（既定目的）是由该局编制统计数据，以便查明无线电设备主要分布在城市的哪些区域。调查之后，将安排将各种无线电广播和发射站迁至合适的地点，以消除普遍存在的信号混乱传输现象。

归档
请附入
档案。JRS

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL
S. P. POLICE
B. D. 6813
Special Branch 24 9 35
September 24 — 35

Registration of Owners of Radio Receiving Sets.

and C.D.I. Grubb

The Bureau of International Telegraphs has published
a notice in the N.C.D.News regarding the enforcement of
registration of radio broadcasting receivers. The notice
(attached) points out that set-owners failing to register
before September 30 will be fined according to Article 21
of the Telegraph Act promulgated by the National Government
on August 5, 1929.

Should it be intended by the Bureau of International
Telegraphs to enforce this Act in the Settlement, it will,
of course, only apply to persons subject to the jurisdiction
of the Shanghai Special District Court.

The attitude of the Council towards the enforcement
of registration in the Settlement is set down in a letter
dated August 10, 1935, to the Commissioner of Police from the
Acting Secretary as follows :-

"Registration of Owners of Radio Receiving Sets.
"It is not the wish of the Council that the
"registration order should be enforced in the Settlement.
"It is proposed to await events rather than take any step
"to oppose the Order at the present time."

C. D. I.

D. C. (Special Branch)

SPECIAL INQUIRY
SHAI MUNICIPAL
S. B. REC
D 68/3
Date 14 / 7 / 35
July 14, 1935.

S. 1.
Please prepare a memorandum on the Enforcement in the Settlement of Chinese Regulations Governing Wireless Sets and Broadcasting. The memorandum should be brief, but should cover all important points. It will be necessary to trace the subject from the time the extention to the Settlement of these regulations was first mooted until they were actually given the force of law.
A brief reference must be made to correspondence exchanged on the subject and meetings which took place. An account should be included of the different national groups and interests represented at these meetings and the differences in their view points which the discussion disclosed.
A paragraph should be devoted to an explanation of why the enforcement of the regulations were deferred, and the change, if any, in general conditions which would justify a change in policy.
Sub-Inspector Harpur has a comprehensive file on this subject and should be able to furnish the data required for the memorandum.

J. Givens
D. C. (Special Branch).

Memorandum on Efforts by Municipal Authorities to Secure
Control of Private Radio Broadcasting Stations in Shanghai.

In November 1932, the Ministry of Communications of the
National Government promulgated a set of regulations governing
Private Radio Broadcasting Stations, a copy of which was sent
to the S.M.C. by the International Telegraph Bureau.
The question of enforcement of the new regulations in the
Settlement and French Concession was at once raised and
a certain amount of correspondence was exchanged between the
S.M.C., French Municipal Council, French Consul-General,
Commissioner of Police and the Associated Advertisers.
The general consensus of opinion of the correspondents was
that it was absolutely necessary that some sort of co-operative
agreement should be reached between the authorities of the three
areas, i.e. International Settlement, French Concession
and Chinese controlled territory before any measures were
taken in the matter of control of broadcasting stations.
Subsequently meetings were held by the different parties,
including the Foreign Councils and Foreign radio merchants,
interested in the control of broadcasting stations and a
by the latter group
resolution was adopted/that the S.M.C. and F.M.C. get into
touch with the Chinese Radio Administration Authorities with
a view to putting the Chinese government regulations into effect

关于市政当局为取得上海私营广播电台控制权所作努力的备忘录。

1932年11月，国民政府交通部颁布了一套管理私营广播电台的规章，其副本由国际电报局送交工部局（S.M.C.）。
随即提出了在租界和法租界执行新规章的问题，工部局、法国公董局、法国总领事、警务处长以及联合广告商之间交换了一定数量的信函。
通信各方的一般共识是，在对广播电台采取任何管制措施之前，三个区域——即公共租界、法租界和中国管辖领土——的当局之间绝对有必要达成某种合作协议。
随后，包括外国公董局和对广播电台管制感兴趣的外国无线电商人在内的各方举行了会议，后者通过了一项决议，即工部局和法国公董局应与中国无线电管理当局取得联系，以便在租界和法租界实施中国政府的规定

was competent to issue the necessary licences for all radio
stations in the Settlement. These suggestions were
understood to have been brought before the Municipal Council
for discussion, but the matter seems to have been dropped,
no definite decision being reached. As regards the attitude
of the French Authorities, the Consul-General for France in
October 1932 published a Consular Ordinance ordering wireless
telegraph stations be added to the list of licensed
establishments, and on the strength of this order, the
French Council drew up regulations for the control of all
radio stations in the Concession and now compel owners to
take out licences.

In 1933 the International Telegraph Bureau of the
Ministry of Communications commenced the inspection of radio
broadcasting stations in the Settlement and in 1934 the same
page_data.zh:
- 2 -
。与此同时，法国公董局建议成立一个国际委员会，由三个当局各派两名成员组成，以确定波长问题并维持联合当局之间的谅解。
工部局秘书表示，最好的方法是像执行《工厂法》那样进行，且只有工部局有权为租界内所有无线电台颁发必要的执照。据理解，这些建议已提交工部局讨论，但此事似乎已被搁置，未作出任何明确决定。至于法国当局的态度，法国驻沪总领事于1932年10月发布了一项领事法令，命令将无线电台列入持牌机构名单，法国公董局依据此令制定了管制租界内所有无线电台的规章，并现在强制业主领取执照。

1933年，交通部国际电报局开始检查租界内的无线广播电台，1934年，该

page_data.en:
- 3 -

Bureau issued registration forms to owners of private
broadcasting and receiving apparatus in the Settlement.
Regarding the distribution of registration forms by the
Chinese radio authorities, the Secretary of the Council in
April 1934 instructed the Commissioner of Police to report
any attempt by the Chinese Authorities to enforce the radio
regulations or to function otherwise in the Settlement, as
this action was deemed inconsistent with the discussions
which took place regarding the enforcement of the regulations
in the Foreign Concessions.

In July 1935, two Search Warrants were received by the
S.M.P. authorising the seizure of certain wireless transmitting
and receiving sets and material, but it was not clear at the time
that the Chinese Authorities intended to apply the radio
regulations in the Settlement. One of these warrants was
executed after the matter had been referred to the Council.
The ruling of the Council on this occasion was embodied in
a letter dated July 10 from the Secretary and is as follows:-

"It is considered that the factor which must determine
"the Council's attitude is not the desirability or
"otherwise of enforcing particular Chinese regulations
"but the desirability of controlling wireless transmission.
"Wireless transmission is universally regarded as a matter
"which should be subject to governmental control. Moreover,
"the activities of wireless transmitters within the
page_data.zh:
- 3 -

局向租界内私人广播和接收设备的所有者发放了登记表。
关于中国无线电当局分发登记表一事，工部局秘书于1934年4月指示警务处长报告中国当局在租界内强制执行无线电规章或以其他任何方式行事的任何企图，因为此举被认为与此前就外国租界内执行规章事宜进行的讨论不符。

1935年7月，上海公共租界警务处（S.M.P.）收到两份搜查令，授权扣押某些无线发射和接收设备及材料，但当时尚不清楚中国当局是否打算在租界内适用无线电规章。其中一份搜查令在该事项提交工部局后得以执行。工部局在此事上的裁决体现于秘书7月10日的一封信中，内容如下：-

“认为决定工部局态度的因素，并非执行特定中国规章是否可取，
而是对无线电传输进行管制是否可取。无线电传输被普遍视为
应受政府管制的事项。此外，租界内无线电发射器的活动

page_data.en:
- 4 -

"Settlement can in fact be hampered or assisted by
"action outside the Settlement.

"It is therefore considered that unless any
"specific cases arise which you may desire in your
"discretion to bring to the attention of the Council
"the ordinary practice of acting upon warrants duly
"issued by the District Court should be followed."

In the case referred to in which a wireless
transmitting and receiving set was seized, at the instance
of the Bureau of Telegraphs, prosecution on summons was
instituted under the Regulations Governing Electrical
Messages, promulgated by the National Government in August
1929. This case was disposed of on July 31, 1935, when
the radio set was confiscated and the owner fined $60.
Regarding the receipt of another search warrant for the
seizure of radio apparatus, referred to on page 3, this
warrant was withdrawn at the instigation of the Shanghai
Telegraph Office, Ministry of Communications.
page_data.zh:
- 4 -

“实际上可能受到租界外行动的阻碍或协助。

“因此，认为除非出现您酌情希望提请
“工部局注意的任何具体案件，否则应遵循
“对地方法院正式签发的搜查令予以执行的
“通常做法。”

在上述提及的案件中，一套无线发射和接收设备应国际电报局的要求被扣押，并根据国民政府于1929年8月颁布的《电信条例》提起传票起诉。该案于1935年7月31日审结，无线电设备被没收，所有者被罚款60元。关于第3页提及的另一份扣押无线电设备的搜查令，该搜查令应交通部上海电报局的要求撤回。

Please find attached hereto original copy of a report
relative to the above entitled matter made by Assistant

The Regulations Governing Electrical Messages is a law
which has been regularly and duly enacted and promulgated
by the Nationalist Government. For your information, we
attach hereto a very rough translation of the regulations.
The law in question does not in any way impinge upon or
conflict with the Land Regulations and Bye-laws. Before
giving any advice relative to the search warrant, we
consulted the Secretary General and were advised to
proceed with its execution. Since the execution of the

Secretary-General, and he expressed the opinion that there
was no reason why these regulations should not be enforced
in the Settlement as against persons subject to Chinese
jurisdiction.

Will you kindly cause the application for summons
to be returned to the Court so that the summons may be
issued and served in the regular way.

We are forwarding a copy of this letter, together with
a copy of the attached report, to the Secretary General

R.T. Bryan, Jr. (signed),

The Acting Commissioner of Police:

        REGISTRATION OF RADIO BROADCASTING
              IN THE SETTLEMENT

    I have discussed with the Secretary-General
your report of July 10, 1935.  It is considered that
the factor which must determine the Council's attitude
is not the desirability or otherwise of enforcing
particular Chinese regulations but the desirability
of controlling wireless transmission.  Wireless trans-
mission is universally regarded as a matter which
should be subject to governmental control.  Moreover,
the activities of wireless transmitters within the
Settlement can in fact be hampered or assisted by action
outside the Settlement.

specific cases arise which you may desire in your
discretion to bring to the attention of the Council

Special Branch
July 9, 1935.

Enforcement of Radio Regulations in the Settlement

On June 29, 1935, a Search Warrant, issued by the District Court for the First Special Area in Shanghai, at the instigation of the Shanghai Telegraph Office, Ministry of Communications, for the seizure of a wireless transmitting and receiving set at 8 The Bund, was forwarded to the Special Branch for execution.

The Warrant was passed to the Municipal Advocate for an opinion as to whether or not it should be executed. The Municipal Advocate expressed the opinion that it should be executed providing the interests of foreigners enjoying extraterritorial rights were not involved. The warrant was executed on July 1, and a wireless transmitting and receiving set seized. Application was made at the Shanghai Special District Court for its disposal and it is now detained by the Court pending further action by the Police.

On July 9, another warrant, issued under the same circumstances, was received for execution within the Settlement.

According to our files the question of enforcing radio regulations in the Settlement on behalf of the Chinese authorities has never been settled.

In November and December of 1932 correspondence passed between the Secretary to the Council and the Commissioner of Police regarding a unified system of control by the three authorities but no ruling was given. In a letter dated April 10, 1934, from the Secretary to the Commissioner of Police a request is made for reports to be submitted of any attempts at enforcing radio regulations or functioning by offices of the Bureau of International Telegraphs in the Settlement and French Concession.

租界内无线电规章的执行

1935年6月29日，一份由上海第一特区地方法院应交通部上海电报局之请签发的搜查令被送至政治部执行，该令旨在搜查并扣押位于外滩8号的一套无线收发报机。

该搜查令已转呈市公廨律师，以征询是否应予执行的意见。市公廨律师表示，若不涉及享有治外法权的外国人利益，则应予执行。该搜查令已于7月1日执行，查获无线收发报机一套。已向上海特区地方法院申请处置该物品，目前由法院扣留，等待警方进一步行动。

7月9日，又收到一份在相同情况下签发的搜查令，要求在租界内执行。

根据我方档案，代表中国当局在租界执行无线电规章的问题从未得到解决。

1932年11月和12月，工部局秘书与警务处处长之间曾就三方统一管制体系问题进行通信往来，但未作出裁决。在1934年4月10日工部局秘书致警务处处长的信中，要求提交任何试图在租界及法租界执行无线电规章或国际电报局官员在租界及法租界开展活动的报告。

Third Branch High Court) and that the installed stations in
the French Concession have been the means by which the misdemeanour
was committed.
2) The two T.S.F. stations indicated in the Search Warrants No.67
and 68 were installed in the F.C. The proceeding which the
presence of these secret installations may eventually give rise
can only be undertaken by one of the Chinese Courts in the F.C.
3) The Warrants are moreover practically null and void, because
they have been issued at the request of an authority - The
Chinese Police who have no authority to try cases in the F.C.
or Nantao. The Authority in the French Concession lying
exclusively within the province of the French Police by virtue
of the ruling of Art. 4 of the Franco/Chinese Agreement, bearing
on the formation of Chinese Courts in the French Concession.

第67号和68号搜查令
1934年5月15日
判例等。

第二特区地方法院于1934年5月15日签发的两份搜查令（附照片及译文）未予执行，理由如下：
1) 并未向实际行为人（本案中名为Wang Shen，别名Wang Keong-pa）提起任何能证明签发搜查令正当性的正规诉讼程序，该人被认为在中国法院管辖范围之外（即第二特区地方法院和高等法院第三分院管辖领土之外）犯有轻罪，而安装在法租界内的电台仅是实施该轻罪的手段。
2) 第67号和68号搜查令中指出的两个无线电台安装在法租界内。这些秘密装置的存在可能最终引发的诉讼程序，只能由法租界内的中国法院之一提起。
3) 此外，这些搜查令实际上无效，因为它们是应一个无权在法租界或南市审理案件的当局——中国警察——的请求而签发的。根据关于在法租界设立中国法院的中法协定第4条之规定，法租界的管辖权完全属于法国警察职权范围。

注：请归档至关于租界内广播接收机及无线装置总体政策的卷宗。J.B. 1935年7月12日

4) Finally the fact of installing and working a wireless
and transmitting station without the authorization of the
lawful authority - if it constitutes an offence outside of
the French Concession, an offence provided for and punished
by a Chinese Administration. Regulations dated August 5, 1929,
cannot only be in the French Concession by the terms of the
Agreement dated July 28, 1931. (To see Chinese text which does
not provide (Art.3 ) the applicability of the "Diao - Li," but
only of "Tsang-Zeng" by Chinese courts in the French Concession)
the object of action to be taken for the violation of municipal
regulations concerning classified establishments Category C.
(Consular Order No.115 Aug. 28, 1928 and Order No.154 Sept.30,
1932.)

In the case of proceedings under the head of accusations,
it is evident that the initiative of the operations to be
effected cannot anymore than proceedings properly called, be
admitted to any other authority except the police of the
French Concession.

-2-

4) 最后，未经合法当局授权安装和使用无线发射台——如果在法租界之外构成由中国行政机关规定并处罚的罪行（1929年8月5日条例），则根据1931年7月28日协定的条款，在法租界内不能仅以此为由采取行动（参见中文文本，其中第3条未规定“条例”的适用性，而仅规定法租界中国法院适用“章程”），其行动对象应为违反关于丙类分类场所市政规章的行为。（1928年8月28日领事命令第115号和1932年9月30日命令第154号。）

在此类指控下的诉讼程序中，显然，除法国租界警察外，不得承认任何其他当局拥有采取行动的主动权，正如不得承认其拥有正式提起诉讼的权利一样。

Les deux mandats de perquisition dont reproduction photogra-
phique et traduction ci-jointes, émis par la 2ème Cour de dis-
trict de la zone spéciale de Shanghai à la date du 15 Mai 1934,
ne sont pas exécutoires pour les motifs suivants:

1°/ Aucune poursuite régulière qui justifierait l'émission
des mandats n'est intentée contre l'auteur présumé, en l'espèce
le nommé WANG-SHEN (王琛) alias WANG-KIUNG-HA (王君白) devant
une Cour Chinoise, à raison de délits commis en dehors de la con-
cession (c'est à dire en dehors du territoire où s'exerce la com-
pétence de la 2ème Cour de district et de la 3ème section de la
Haute Cour) et pour lesquels les postes installés sur la Conces-
sion Française auraient été des moyens d'exécution accessoires.

2°/ Les deux stations de T.S.F. indiquées dans les mandats
de perquisition Nos 67 et 68 étant installées sur la Concession
Française, les poursuites auxquelles cette installation clandes-
tine, pourraient éventuellement donner lieu, ne peuvent, en tout
état de cause, être entendues que devant l'une des Cours Chinoises
de la Concession Française.

3°/ Les mandats sont, enfin, entachés de nullité du fait
qu'ils ont été émis à la demande d'une autorité - en l'espèce la
Police Chinoise - qui ne jouit du privilège de représenter l'ac-

TRANSLATION FROM FRENCH CONSULAR ORDER NOS 732 dated June 10, 1933.
AND 270 dated October 23, 1934.

REGULATIONS GOVERNING PRIVATE WIRELESS STATIONS.

ARTICLE 1. The regulations governing wireless stations. These posts
are governed by all previous regulations, with the
exception of those articles cancelled by the present rules,
subject to the arrangement on the establishment classes.

ARTICLE 2. The station is named "Wireless Radiotelephone Transmitting
Station" and all stations of T.S.F. the waves of which
are modified to speech and music.

ARTICLE 3. The data required by regulation 5 of the establishment
will be sent to the office of the Establishment Classes,
and will contain the following particulars.
"Questionaire containing the follwing questions".
a). Name of the person or society who wishes to
establish the station.
b). Position of the transmitting Room and Studio.
c). Strength of transmission in Watts and Kilocycles,
which will be used for broadcasting.
d). Object, nature and time of transmission.
also the following will be added:-
1). A plan of the set.
2). A plan to the scale of 1/200 of the premises
occupied.

The owner will have to accept the present Municipal
Rules as well as any rules which might be issued in the
future.

ARTICLE 4. The Municipal Authorities will assign to the station a
certain wave length, which will be adhered to.
The amplitude of the frequency band used on
transmission should not be exceeded in case of interference
of broadcast of other stations.

译自1933年6月10日第732号及1934年10月23日第270号法国领事馆命令。

私人无线电台管理条例。

第一条. 无线电台管理条例。除本规则废止的条款外，此类电台均受以往所有条例管辖，并须遵守关于分类场所的规定。

第二条. 凡无线电报（T.S.F.）电波经调制用于传输语音和音乐的电台，均称为“无线电话发射台”。

第三条. 根据分类场所条例第五条规定所需的数据，应报送至分类场所管理处办公室，并包含以下详细信息。
“包含下列问题的问卷”：
a). 希望设立电台的个人或社团名称。
b). 发射室和演播室的位置。
c). 用于广播的发射功率（瓦特）和频率（千周）。
d). 发射的目的、性质和时间。
此外还需附加以下内容：-
1). 设备平面图。
2). 占用场所的1/200比例平面图。

业主必须接受现行的工部局规章以及未来可能颁布的任何规章。

第四条. 工部局当局将为该电台指定一个特定的波长，电台必须严格遵守。
为避免干扰其他电台的广播，发射时使用的频带幅度不得超出规定范围。

page_data.en:
-2-

ARTICLE 5. The wave length will be kept at the authorised frequency
as well as the scientific conditions of the permit.
The radiations will be exempt from all transmission that is
not essential to effective communication.

ARTICLE 6. Wireless Stations are prohibited from the following:-
a). .Broadcasting political propoganda, or the
announcing of false rumours.
b). Giging programmes contrary to the public morals.
c). Interrupting the broadcast of other radio
stations.

ARTICLE 7. All modifications which will felicitate broadcasting will be
submitted to the Municipal Administration for approval.

ARTICLE 8. The Licence, besides covering the Class Establishment "C"
also gives authority to conduct experiments.
The licence does not guarantee immunity from interference
from other broadcasting stations.

ARTICLE 9. The Licence is valid from the January 1. to December 31,
and cannot be transferred without the authority of the
Municipal Administration.
The Price of the licence is (see list of taxes).

ARTICLE 10. The authority to experiment is liable to be cancelled, and the
licence will be withdrawn, without compensation, for the
following reasons.
a). If the owner is guilty of an infringement of the
present rules and the rules of the establishment
classes.
b). if the owner does not observe the conditions which
have been imposed on the establishment and working
of a station.
c). If the owner uses his post for any other object
than that stated in his application form.
d). If he interferes in any way whatsoever in the
functioning of Public Utility Services such as
Wireless and Radio Telephone message by using
a high or a low frequency.
page_data.zh:
-2-

第五条. 波长应保持在许可规定的授权频率及科学条件范围内。
辐射信号中不得包含对有效通信非必要的任何发射内容。

第六条. 无线电台禁止从事以下行为：-
a). 广播政治宣传，或发布虚假谣言。
b. (原文拼写错误: Giging) 播出违背公共道德的节目。
c). 干扰其他广播电台的广播。

第七条. 所有旨在改善广播效果的修改方案，均须提交工部局审批。

第八条. 许可证除涵盖“C类”分类场所外，还授予进行实验的权限。
该许可证不保证免受其他广播电台的干扰。

第九条. 许可证有效期为1月1日至12月31日，未经工部局批准不得转让。
许可证费用见（税捐清单）。

第十条. 出现以下情况时，实验权限可能被取消，许可证将被无偿收回：
a). 如果业主违反本规则及分类场所规则。
b). 如果业主未遵守对电台设立和运行所施加的条件。
c). 如果业主将电台用于申请表所述目的以外的任何其他用途。
d). 如果其通过使用高频或低频，以任何方式干扰公用事业服务（如无线电和无线电话报文）的运行。

Art. 1 - Les dispositions spéciales ci-dessous régiront les
postes d'émissions radiophoniques.
    Ces postes restent en tout ce qui n'y est pas dérogé
par le présent règlement, soumis aux dispositions générales

ments Classés. Elle comprendra les pièces suivantes :

le poste,

    - puissance antenne rayonnée en watts et longueur d'onde
que l'on se propose d'adopter,

glements municipaux présents et futurs.

devra répondre raisonnablement aux progrès de la technique,

EXTRA COPY

December 16, 1932.

The Secretary,
S. M. C.

Reference your letters No.4385, dated the 29th
November and 30th November respectively.

It is an admitted fact that some form of official
control of radio broadcasting is essential. Apart from
the general complaint as to the chaotic state of affairs
in this respect I may state that the Police Broadcasting
has been very seriously interfered with during the year
and in most cases it has been found that the mushroom
growth of irresponsible broadcasting establishments under
no form of control is responsible. There is further the
great danger that uncontrolled radio broadcasting will
present in the near future a serious menace to the peace
and good order of the Settlement as there are many evil
uses to which radio broadcasting can be put.

Control in the Settlement without a similar form of
control in the French Concession and in Chinese Territory
would be useless. There is a limit to the number of
broadcasting stations that can operate in the three areas,
and without co-operation between the three authorities the
allotting of wave lengths would not be possible. It is,
therefore, obvious that a satisfactory system of control
can be introduced only if the three authorities come to a
common agreement on the number of stations to be permitted
in each area and the wave lengths to be allotted to each
station.
page_data.zh:
副本

1932年12月16日。

秘书，
上海公共租界工部局 (S. M. C.)。

参照您分别于11月29日和11月30日发出的第4385号信函。

官方对无线电广播进行某种形式的控制是必要的，这是一个公认的事实。除了对此方面混乱状况的一般抱怨外，我可以指出，警方的广播在这一年中受到了非常严重的干扰，且在大多数情况下，发现原因是大量不负责任的广播电台在没有任何形式控制的情况下如雨后春笋般涌现。此外，不受控制的无线电广播在不久的将来会对租界的和平与良好秩序构成严重威胁，因为无线电广播可能被用于许多邪恶用途。

如果在法租界和中国领土上没有类似形式的控制，那么在租界实施控制将是徒劳的。在这三个区域能够运营的广播电台数量是有限的，如果没有这三个当局之间的合作，就不可能分配波长。因此，显而易见的是，只有当这三个当局就每个区域允许的电台数量以及分配给每个电台的波长达成共同协议时，才能引入令人满意的控制系统。

page_data.en:
-- 2 --

The new Chinese regulations, if they were applied in
the Settlement, would effect Chinese owned stations only
and Foreign owned stations could operate without control.
The application of these regulations would not therefore
solve the difficulty.

It would therefore appear necessary that a general
working agreement be come to between the authorities of the
three areas, and that suitable licensing byelaws be intro-
duced in accordance with such agreement which could be
enforced in the Settlement in the case of all radio broad-
casting stations, whether Foreign or Chinese owned.

If suitable byelaws are introduced, it would not be
difficult for the Police to enforce them.

(signed) F. W. Gerrard.

Commissioner of Police.
page_data.zh:
-- 2 --

如果新的中国法规在租界适用，将仅影响华人拥有的电台，而外商拥有的电台则可以在不受控制的情况下运营。因此，适用这些法规并不能解决这一困难。

因此，似乎有必要由这三个区域的当局达成一项总体工作协议，并根据该协议引入适当的许可附例，以便在租界对所有无线电广播电台（无论是外商拥有还是华人拥有）强制执行。

如果引入了适当的附例，警方执行起来并不困难。

（签名）F. W. Gerrard.

警务处处长。

1932年11月30日

致警务处处长

继我昨日关于在无线电事务上与法国当局合作的口头指令之后，现随函附上从交通部收到的管理广播电台规章的译本副本。我很高兴听到您对此事以及与法国当局合作的一般问题的看法。

我还附上1932年10月16日刊登在《市政公报》上的法国领事馆法令译本副本，以及收到的一封关于同一主题的广告商协会来信副本。

（签名）J.R. Jones.

page_data.en:
Provisional Regulations Limiting Private Radio
Broadcasting Stations.
Promulgated by the Ministry of Communications
on November 24, 1932.

ARTICLE 1. Where radio transmitters are used in broadcasting
speech and music, such place shall be called a radio
broadcasting station. The establishment and operation
of the same shall be in accordance with the provisions
of these Regulations.

ARTICLE 2. Citizens of the Republic of China, corporations with
all Chinese capital, schools and organizations duly
registered with the National Government and/or other
organizations legally organized may establish and
operate radio broadcasting stations in China, provided
that such stations may be constructed only after permits
have been first obtained from the Ministry of Communica-
tions. Corporations which do not have all Chinese capital
and organizations not managed entirely by Chinese citizens
must be registered with the National Government. After
registration certificates have been obtained, permits
may be applied for and radion broadcasting stations
established in China.

ARTICLE 3. The following particulars must be fully stated by a
responsible representative in the application for permits
to construct radio broadcasting stations :-
( 1 ) Name, organization, domicile, and manager
of the station.
( 2 ) Object of the station.
( 3 ) Name of the station together with a business
prospectus therefor.
( 4 ) Power of the transmitter, location and detailed
engineering plans. (To be accompanied by drawings)
( 5 ) Location of the broadcasting room.

ARTICLE 4. Each application must be accompanied by a fee of $10
for the permit and $1 stamp duty.
page_data.zh:
限制私人广播电台暂行条例。
由交通部于1932年11月24日公布。

第一条. 凡使用无线电发射机广播讲话和音乐者，该场所称为无线电广播电台。其设立和运营应依照本条例之规定。

第二条. 中华民国公民、全华资公司、向国民政府正式注册的学校和组织，和/或其他合法组织的机构，可以在中国设立和运营无线电广播电台，但此类电台必须在首先获得交通部颁发的许可证后方可建设。非全华资公司及并非完全由中华民国公民管理的组织，必须向国民政府注册。在获得注册证书后，可申请许可证并在中国设立无线电广播电台。

第三条. 在申请建设无线电广播电台的许可证时，责任代表必须充分陈述以下详情：
( 1 ) 电台的名称、组织、住所及经理。
( 2 ) 电台的宗旨。
( 3 ) 电台名称及其营业计划书。
( 4 ) 发射机的功率、位置及详细工程图纸。（需附图纸）
( 5 ) 播音室的位置。

第四条. 每份申请必须附带10美元的许可证费和1美元的印花税。

page_data.en:
( 2 )

ARTICLE 5. The permits are to remain effective for six months
from the date of issue. However, should the applicant
fail to complete the station within this period due
to some special cause, an extension of three months
will be granted upon application to the Ministry of
Communications. Such extension can be granted once
only.

ARTICLE 6. Upon the completion of the construction of the radio
broadcasting station, its manner of construction,
machines and other equipments shall be examined by
special representatives from the Ministry of Communi-
cations. If they are satisfied that everything is in
order, a licence to operate a radio broadcasting
station will be issued and the permit for construction
of the same be revoked.

ARTICLE 7. Each application for licence must be accompanied with
a licence fee of $50, stamp duty of $2, together with
a cash security of $200 or a reliable shop guarantee
of $1000. In case no fines are imposed and deducted
from the cash security or after impositions of fines
there is still some money on deposit, the whole or the
part remaining will be refunded to the licensee upon
termination of his business or upon expiration of the
period stipulated in the licence.

ARTICLE 8. When the formal regulations governing radio broad-
casting stations are promulgated, a new licence shall
be applied for.

ARTICLE 9. In case the licence is lost or modifications are to be
made in respect of the matters stipulated therein, the
holder must inform the Ministry of Communications and
shall submit an application containing reasons within
7 days to the Ministry for another licence to be issued.
page_data.zh:
( 2 )

第五条. 许可证自签发之日起六个月内有效。但是，如果申请人因特殊原因未能在此期限内完成电台建设，可向交通部申请延长三个月。此种延期仅可授予一次。

第六条. 无线电广播电台建设完成后，其建设方式、机器及其他设备应由交通部特派代表进行检查。如果他们认为一切符合要求，将颁发无线电广播电台运营许可证，并撤销其建设许可证。

第七条. 每份许可证申请必须附带50美元许可证费、2美元印花税，以及200美元现金保证金或1000美元可靠商号担保。如果未处以罚款并从现金保证金中扣除，或在处以罚款后仍有存款余额，全部或部分剩余款项将在持证人终止业务或许可证规定期限届满时退还给持证人。

第八条. 当管理无线电广播电台的正式法规颁布时，应申请新的许可证。

第九条. 如果许可证遗失或其中规定的事项需要修改，持有人必须通知交通部，并在7天内向交通部提交包含理由的申请，以便颁发新的许可证。

page_data.en:
-- 3 --

Article 10 · Application for the issuance of a
ne.. license or for the changing a license must be
accompanied with a license fee and stamp duty fee
in accordance with .rticle 7. This provision shall
not apply, however, if the license is changed by
order of the Ministry of Communications.
Article 11 Licenses for radio broadcasting stations
are not transferable.
Article 12 The calling signals of the radio
broadcasting stations shall be designated by the Ministry
of Communications.
Article 13 The frequency used by radio broadcasting
stations shall be designated by the Ministry of Communi-
cations. The said Ministry shall test and regulate the
frequency from time to tine, so that there shall not be
a difference of exceeding 2/1000th of the designated
frequency.
Article 14 The operator of a station must try his
best to reduce the power of the tuning wave on the
aerial as low as possible in order to avoid interference
with other stations. If the power of the tuning wave
is too great, the Ministry of Communications may from
time to time order him to improve it or to suspend
operation.
Article 15 During broadcasting, a radio broad-
casting station must announce its calling signal once
every thirty minutes and give a brief report in respect
of the frequency used by said station.
Article 16 The Ministry of Communications may,
whenever it shall deem fit, alter the stipulations
contained in the license and the provisions of rticles
10 and 11.
page_data.zh:
-- 3 --

第十条 · 申请颁发新许可证或变更许可证，必须按照第七条的规定附带许可证费和印花税。但是，如果许可证是根据交通部的命令进行变更的，则不适用此规定。
第十一条 无线电广播电台的许可证不得转让。
第十二条 无线电广播电台的呼号由交通部指定。
第十三条 无线电广播电台使用的频率由交通部指定。该部应不时测试和调节频率，使其与指定频率的偏差不超过千分之二。
第十四条 电台操作员必须尽力将天线上的调谐波功率降至尽可能低的水平，以避免干扰其他电台。如果调谐波功率过大，交通部可随时命令其改进或暂停运营。
第十五条 在广播期间，无线电广播电台必须每三十分钟播报一次其呼号，并简要报告该电台使用的频率。
第十六条 交通部认为适当时，可以更改许可证中包含的规定以及第十条和第十一条的规定。

page_data.en:
-- 4 --

Article 17 The subjects of broadcasting must be
confined to the following:-
(1) Lectures or speeches calculated to promote
public welfare.
(2) News reports (subject however to prohibition
in case of necessity)
(3) Music, songs and other similar programmes.
(4) Reports concerning business matters (provided
that the time taken up does not exceed 20% of
the daily broadcasting hours)

Article 18 The Ministry of Communications may
instruct private broadcasting stations to broadcast
Government news concerning government activities and
beneficial to the public. Should the Ministry
propaganda/deem necessary, such government news must
be broadcast before the ordinary programmes of the
station.

Article 19 In case of emergency calls from stations
on board ships or airplanes, all private stations, upon
receiving same or being notified by the stations
along the coast or in the interior controlled by
the Ministry of Communications, must stop broadcasting
immediately, in order to avoid disturbing such calls
and to facilitate the trasmission of the emergency
calls. The said stations must ascertain that the
transmission of the emergency calls has actually
ended or are assured of that no disturbance will
result, before the broadcasting may be continued
according to the original programme.

Article 20 No broacasting station which has not
duly obtained the necessary licence from the Ministry
or whose licence has been revoked or lost and a new
licence not been applied for will be allowed to operate.

Article 21 The Ministry may appoint special
representatives to examine and inspect, from time to
time, t e documents, licences, books, charts and
tables of the various stations. Stations are not
allowed to refuse examination or inspection on any
page_data.zh:
-- 4 --

第十七条 广播内容必须限于以下范围：
(1) 旨在促进公共福利的讲座或演讲。
(2) 新闻报道（但在必要时可予以禁止）
(3) 音乐、歌曲及其他类似节目。
(4) 有关商业事务的报告（但所占时间不得超过每日广播时间的20%）

第十八条 交通部可指示私人广播电台广播有关政府活动且有益于公众的政府新闻。如果交通部认为必要/进行宣传，此类政府新闻必须在电台常规节目前播出。

第十九条 如遇船舶或飞机上的电台发出紧急呼叫，所有私人电台在收到此类呼叫或接到交通部控制的沿海或内陆电台通知后，必须立即停止广播，以避免干扰此类呼叫并便于紧急呼叫的传输。上述电台必须确认紧急呼叫的实际传输已经结束，或确信不会造成干扰后，方可按照原计划继续广播。

第二十条 任何未从交通部正式获得必要许可证，或其许可证已被撤销或遗失且未申请新许可证的广播电台，均不得运营。

第二十一条 交通部可指派特派代表不时检查各电台的文件、许可证、账簿、图表和表格。电台不得以任何理由拒绝检查或视察

page_data.en:
-- 5 --

pretext.
Article 22 No private radio station shall violate
any one of the following conditions:-
(1) To disturb or hamper the operation of Government,
Military or Naval and public broadcasting stations.
(2) To disobey the instructions or direction of
special representatives sent by the Ministry of
Communications.
(3) To communicate with any broadcasting station.
(4) To broadcast unauthentic news.
(5) To transmit private messages.
(6) To broadcast news, speeches, songs or stories
which are contrary to public peace or good
morals.
(7) To disturb the broadcasting of other stations.
Article 23 Provisions of the International Radio
Broadcast Convention and its appendices, in so far as
they are not contrary to these Regulations, will also
be considered applicable in regard to private broadcasting
stations.
Article 24 All laws, statutes and orders promulgated
by the Ministry of Communications of the National
Government and the various provisional rules governing
wireless telegraphy, in so far as they are not contrary
to these Regulations, will also be considered applicable
in regard to private broadcasting stations.
Article 25 In the event of any station violates any
one of the provisions of these Regulations, the Ministry
of Communications may impose any of the following
penalties:-
(1) Suspension of operation.
(2) Revocation of licence
(3) Confiscation of radio apparatus and/or a fine
of not less than $50 and not more than $2,000.
page_data.zh:
-- 5 --

借口。
第二十二条 任何私人无线电台不得违反下列任一条件：-
(1) 干扰或妨碍政府、军事、海军及公共广播电台的运作。
(2) 不服从交通部派出的特别代表的指示或指令。
(3) 与任何广播电台进行通信。
(4) 广播虚假新闻。
(5) 传送私人信息。
(6) 广播违背公共安宁或良好道德的新闻、演讲、歌曲或故事。
(7) 干扰其他电台的广播。
第二十三条 《国际无线电广播公约》及其附件的规定，在不与本规章相抵触的范围内，亦被视为适用于私人广播电台。
第二十四条 国民政府交通部颁布的所有法律、法规及命令，以及管理无线电报的各项暂行规则，在不与本规章相抵触的范围内，亦被视为适用于私人广播电台。
第二十五条 若任何电台违反本规章的任何规定，交通部可施加下列任何一种处罚：-
(1) 停止运营。
(2) 吊销执照
(3) 没收无线电设备和/或处以不少于50元且不超过2,000元的罚款。

page_data.en:
-- 6 --

Article 26 In case of violation of any of the
provisions of these Regulations by a radio broadcasting
station, the person in charge of it shall bear the
entire responsibility.

Article 27 Any deficiencies in these Regulations
may be made and promulgated by the Ministry of Communi-
cations from time to time.

Article 28 These Regulations shall be enforced on
the day of their promulgation.
page_data.zh:
-- 6 --

第二十六条 若广播电台违反本规章的任何规定，其负责人应承担全部责任。

第二十七条 本规章的任何缺漏，可由交通部随时制定并颁布补充规定。

第二十八条 本规章自颁布之日起施行。

EXTRA FROM A LETTER OF SECRETARY,S.M.C. TO THE
COMMISSIONER OF POLICE

29th November, 1932.

The Commissioner of Police:

Mr. Jacques Coiffard, of the French Consulate
General, called on me yesterday and showed me the new
radio regulations of the National Government which were
published in yesterday's press. These regulations
envisage the licensing and inspecting, to be enforced
by fines and confiscation, of radio stations and their
apparatus in Shanghai.

The French Consul General and the French
Municipal authorities are anxious to regulate the
activities of these stations in the Concession, and
they are very anxious to obtain the co-operation of
the Council and, if possible, of the Chinese authorities.
So far as the co-operation of the Chinese authorities
is concerned Mr. Coiffard suggested that it might be
possible to arrange a different wave length for each
of the three municipalities.

The French authorities are already endeavouring
to license these stations, and as they are uncertain as to
the means of enforcement at present until they have the
co-operation of the Settlement they attempt to do so by
means of a provisional licence.

It is unlikely that the Council would allow
the inspection and enforcement by confiscation or other-
wise of the new rules in the Settlement. I shall be
very glad, however, to have your views upon the new regu-
lations and the question of the possibility of the enforce-
ment of some of them by the Council under a scheme which
page_data.zh:

工部局秘书致警务处处长的信函摘录

1932年11月29日。

致警务处处长：

法国总领事馆的雅克·科伊法尔（Jacques Coiffard）先生昨日拜访了我，并向我展示了昨日报刊上刊登的国民政府新无线电规章。这些规章规定对上海的无线电台及其设备实行许可和检查制度，并通过罚款和没收手段予以强制执行。

法国总领事和法国市政当局迫切希望规范租界内这些电台的活动，他们非常渴望获得工部局的合作，如果可能的话，还希望获得中国当局的合作。就中国当局的合作而言，科伊法尔先生建议，或许可以为三个市政区各自安排不同的波长。

法国当局已经在努力对这些电台发放许可证，但由于目前尚不确定在没有租界合作情况下的执行手段，他们试图通过发放临时许可证的方式来做到这一点。

工部局不太可能允许在租界内通过没收或其他手段检查和执行新规章。然而，我非常乐意听取您对新规章的看法，以及在某种方案下由工部局执行其中部分规定的可能性问题，该方案

page_data.en:
-- 2 --

would involve inspection and enforcement by the Council
in co-operation with the French authorities. It is
suggested that an expert from the Police might consult
with the French Consulate General to discuss the matter
in a preliminary way.
    Mr. Coiffard handed me a list of radio station
in Shanghai and particularly referred to a station in the
Settlement, Ho Tung & Co., 598 Ningpo Road, which was giving
them considerable trouble.
    I enclose the statement given me by Mr. Coiffard
as well as a list of short wave stations published in the
"Amateur Radio" of November 15.

                        (signed)   J. R. Jones.
                                   Secretary.

Encls.
DB.
page_data.zh:
-- 2 --

将涉及工部局与法国当局合作进行检查和执行。建议由警务处的一名专家与法国总领事馆进行初步磋商，讨论此事。
    科伊法尔先生交给我一份上海无线电台名单，并特别提到了位于租界内宁波路598号的何东公司（Ho Tung & Co.）的一家台站，该台站给他们带来了相当大的麻烦。
    随函附上科伊法尔先生给我的陈述，以及11月15日《业余无线电》（Amateur Radio）上刊登的短波电台名单。

SPECIAL INQUIRY
①
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGI...
No. D 618
Date ... / ... / ...
July 14, 1935.

S. 1.
Please prepare a memorandum on the Enforcement in the Settlement of Chinese Regulations Governing Wireless Sets and Broadcasting. The memorandum should be brief, but should cover all important points. It will be necessary to trace the subject from the time the extention to the Settlement of these regulations was first mooted until they were actually given the force of law.

A brief reference must be made to correspondence exchanged on the subject and meetings which took place. An account should be included of the different national groups and interests represented at these meetings and the differences in their view points which the discussion disclosed.

A paragraph should be devoted to an explanation of why the enforcement of the regulations were deferred, and the change, if any, in general conditions which would justify a change in policy.

Sub-Inspector Harpur has a comprehensive file on this subject and should be able to furnish the data required for the memorandum.

（签名）
D. C. (Special Branch).

S. 1.
请就中国关于无线电装置和广播的规章在租界内的执行情况准备一份备忘录。备忘录应简明扼要，但应涵盖所有重要要点。有必要追溯该主题，从首次提出将这些规章扩展至租界之时起，直到它们实际具有法律效力为止。

必须简要提及就此问题交换的信函和举行的会议。说明中应包括在这些会议上代表的不同国籍群体和利益集团，以及讨论所揭示的观点差异。

应有一段专门解释为何推迟执行这些规章，以及总体状况中是否有任何变化足以证明政策调整的合理性。

副督察哈普尔（Harpur）拥有关于此主题的完整档案，应能提供备忘录所需的数据。

Translation of despatch No.450 to Council
from the Bureau of Social Affairs,
Tsingtao City Government.
Dated: Tsingtao, 7th September, 1935.

Private radio set.

We have received the following petition from the Stock and
Produce Exchange in this city:

"The former Currency Department (Brokers' Association)
of this Exchange has written us as follows:

'On 19th September, 1932, when your Exchange com-
menced business, our Association established in Shanghai
a radio station for the quick transmission of market re-
ports. For special reasons our Association was soon after
dissolved. The radio set was packed up and stored with
the Shanghai office of the Li Fung Establishment (利豐號
申莊). Later, when that Establishment closed, the
set was sent by Chiang Tseng-hei (姜振海), an employe
of the Nyi Zeng Ho Shop (義成和), to a certain Mo Ching-
tong (馬錦堂) for temporary keeping. A letter from
Chiang Tseng-hei states:

The radio set has been discovered and seized by
the Council. I declared it to be the property of the
Tsingtao Stock and Produce Exchange but was told that
if this is so, the Tsingtao Exchange should write to
the Council to confirm the statement (number and make
of the set must be given) and the set will be released
if nothing irregular attaches to it.'

This is to confirm the declaration as being correct. Your
Bureau is asked to request the Council to release the set."

Will the Council kindly look into the matter. A statement
of the number, make and other particulars of the radio set sub-
mitted by the petitioner is enclosed herewith. Reply solicited.

(chopped)
Zu Tseng.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL / SECRETARIAT / TRANSLATION OFFICE）

日期：青岛，1935年9月7日。

私人无线电装置。

我们收到本市股票物品交易所的以下请愿书：

“本交易所前货币部（经纪人协会）致函我方如下：

‘1932年9月19日，当贵交易所开始营业时，我方协会在上海设立了一个无线电台，以便快速传输市场报告。由于特殊原因，我方协会不久后解散。无线电装置被打包并存放在利豐號（Li Fung Establishment）上海办事处。后来，当该商号关闭时，该装置由義成和（Nyi Zeng Ho Shop）的雇员姜振海（Chiang Tseng-hei）送往某位马锦堂（Mo Ching-tong）处暂时保管。姜振海的来信称：

该无线电装置已被工部局发现并扣押。我声明其为青岛股票物品交易所的财产，但被告知如果是这样，青岛交易所应致函工部局以确认该声明（必须提供装置的编号和品牌），如果没有任何违规行为，该装置将被释放。’

兹确认该声明正确无误。请贵局请求工部局释放该装置。”

恳请工部局调查此事。随函附上申请人提交的无线电装置的编号、品牌及其他详细信息的陈述。盼复。

（盖章）
Zu Tseng.

Mr. Chiang Tsung-hai,
c/o Doong Foh Lur (同福樓), shop,
corner of Canton & Kiangse Roads.
Mr. Tsung-hai,
We received your letter the day before yesterday. We have noted that the radio set of the Exchange has been seized by the Telegraph Administration with the assistance of the S.M.C. As the attendance did not know the exact circumstances, they wrote a letter to Sung Tung-chuen (宋東川) of the Doong Lee (同利) Firm. Yours, etc.
Wong Ta-chun."

THE CHINA PRESS, FRIDAY, JULY 5, 1935
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / S. B. REGISTRY. / No. D 6513 / Date 6 / 7 / 35）

Police Investigate
Unregistered Radio Set

Settlement police are investigating circumstances concerning the operation of an unregistered radio station, seized two days ago in a godown at 8 the Bund.

The radio was not in operation at the time it was seized nor was anyone found on the premises. It was discovered in a small room on the premises and the equipment, consisting of both receiving and sending sets, was found in a box.

Nothing of a communistic nature in connection with the operation of the equipment has yet been discovered by the police. The set has been shown to the judges of the First Special District Court, where it is now being kept pending further investigation.

警方调查
未注册无线电收发报机

租界警方正在调查有关一台未注册无线电台运营的情况，该电台于两天前在外滩8号的一间仓库内被查获。

查获时，该无线电设备并未运行，现场也未发现任何人。它是在该处所的一间小房间内被发现的，其设备包括接收机和发报机，装在一个箱子里。

警方尚未发现与该设备运营有关的任何共产主义性质的内容。该套设备已出示给第一特区地方法院的法官审阅，目前正存于该院，以待进一步调查。

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, THURSDAY, JULY 4, 1935

RED RADIO STATION
OWNERS SOUGHT

Settlement Police Make
Raid On Private
Station Here

The Chinese Government's ac-
tion in preventing communists
and other seditious elements in
Shanghai from communicating
with their comrades in the in-
terior has now been revealed in
an order issued by the Ministry
of Communications prohibiting
private radio station in Shanghai.
In accordance with this policy
the Settlement police has con-
ducted a raid on such a radio
station where a radio set equip-
ped with both sending and receiv-
ing apparatus has been seized.

This radio set has been shown
to the Judges of the First Special
District Court where it is now be-
ing kept in custody pending fur-
ther investigations. It is under-
stood that should police investiga-
tions reveal that the radio station
has been existing for carrying on
reactionary work detrimental to
the Republic, then the alleged
owner will be charged.

The raid recently took place at
8 Whangpoo Road. Armed with
a search warrant several foreign
and Chinese police officers of the
S.M.P. visited the premises of the
hong and there in a small room
they found a wooden box contain-
ing the radio set.

The Ministry of Communica-
tions has advertised in leading
Chinese newspapers during the
past few weeks asking the public
to give information about secret
radio stations. Rewards ranging
from $100 to $300 are posted and
those who give information
will have their names kept secret.

《字林西报》，1935年7月4日，星期四

红色电台
缉拿业主

工部局警察突袭
本地一私人电台

中国政府为防止上海的共产党人及其他煽动性分子与内地的同伙联络，现已通过交通部发布的一项禁令予以揭露，该禁令禁止在上海设立私人电台。根据这一政策，工部局警察对一处此类电台进行了突袭，查获了一台配备有发射和接收装置的无线电设备。

该无线电设备已呈交第一特区地方法院法官查验，目前正由法院保管，以待进一步调查。据悉，若警方调查显示该电台的存在旨在从事危害民国的反动活动，则将被指控的业主将被提起公诉。

此次突袭近日发生在黄浦路8号。几名持有搜查令的工部局外籍和华籍警员走访了该商号的处所，在一间小房间内发现了一个木箱，箱内装有该无线电设备。

在过去几周内，交通部已在主要中文报纸上刊登广告，呼吁公众提供有关秘密电台的信息。悬赏金额从100元至300元不等，并提供线报者姓名将予以保密。

At 11 a.m. July 1, D.S. McKeown and Clerk Kao (Special
Branch) accompanied by a service inspector of the Chinese
Telegraph Administration named T.Y. Tsih ( 盛再玉 ), and
with the assistance of D.S. Nancarrow, D.S.I. Chiang Ming Teh,
and C.D.S.115 (Central), proceeded to the premises of the
Tong Yoeh Kong Hong ( 東悦公報聞行 ), No.8 The Bund, to execute
search warrant No.7184 issued by Judge Dzun to search for and
seize a wireless sending and receiving set. In the absence
of the manager of the hong, the warrant was shown to the
secretary, one named Zee Yung Ziang ( 徐永祥 ). A search
of the premises was conducted, and the wireless set located
stored in a crate in the corridor on the ground floor. Enquiries
elicited the information that the crate had been left there
about two years ago by one named Chiang Tsung-hai ( 姜振海 ),
a customer, residing at 44 Canton Road (the new premises of
the Tong Yoeh Kong Hong). Chiang Tsunghai was located and
expressed willingness to proceed to Central Station. This
man stated that he is not the owner of the set but that the
Exchange Federation (Tsingtao) had sent it to Shanghai for
the purpose of sending business messages to Tsingtao. However,
the necessity for sending these messages failed to materialize,
and the set was entrusted to his care by a member of the
Exchange Federation. The custodian is of the opinion that
the set had been purchased with the permission of the Chinese
Authorities. A copy of the complete statement is attached.
In the presence of the custodian of the set, Chiang Tsung-
-hai, the service inspector T. Y. Tsih and D.S. McKeown, P.S.
Moss (C.C.R.) made an inventory of the contents of the crate
(copy attached). The crate was then closed and sealed. P.S.

Tsih（盛再玉）的陪同下，并在警探Nancarrow、华籍巡官Chiang Ming Teh及中央巡捕房第115号华籍巡捕（C.D.S.115 (Central)）的协助下，前往外滩8号“东悦公报关行”（Tong Yoeh Kong Hong）的处所，执行由Dzun法官签发的第7184号搜查令，以搜寻并扣押一套无线收发报机。由于该行经理不在，搜查令向秘书徐永祥（Zee Yung Ziang）出示。经对该处所进行搜查，发现无线电台装在一个板条箱内，存放于一楼走廊。经查询获悉，该板条箱系约两年前由一名顾客姜振海（Chiang Tsung-hai）留置于此，其住址为广东路44号（即东悦公报关行的新址）。随后找到姜振海，他表示愿意前往中央巡捕房。此人声称他并非该套设备的所有者，而是交易所联合会（青岛）将其寄至上海，旨在向青岛发送商务讯息。然而，发送这些讯息的必要性并未成为现实，该套设备由交易所联合会的一名成员委托其保管。保管人认为，该套设备的购买已获中国当局许可。完整陈述的副本附后。在该套设备的保管人姜振海、服务督察T. SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of Chiang Tsung-hai (姜振海)
native of Shantung taken by me D. S. McKeown (Special Br.)
at Central on the 1 p.m. July 1, 1935 and interpreted by Clerk Kao Yan-keng
(Sp. Br.)

My name is Chiang Tsung-hai, native of Shantung, aged 21
and single. I am living in the new office of the Tung Yoh
Kung (東悅公) Shipping Hong, 44 Canton Road. I am an
exchange broker by profession but am at present unemployed.
I have no connection with the Tung Yoh Kung Shipping
Hong. I reside with my friend Ma Ching-dong (馬錦堂), who
is a customer of h_ Shipping Hong and lives on the hong
premises.
(It is of interest to note that as a rule these hongs,
apart from carrying on their business, supply lodging to inland
customers who are conducting business in Shanghai.) 伽
Following the Mukden Incident (September 18, 1931), the
brokers of the Money and Cotton Yarn Exchange at Tsingtao
divided into two parties, one controlled by the Japanese and
the other by the Chinese.
With a view to facilitating communication of news on
markets between Shanghai and Tsingtao, the members of the
Chinese exchange, of whom I was one, decided to instal
wireless apparatus at both Tsingtao and Shanghai. I
recollect that the installation was made with the sanction
of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce at Tsingtao.
Two sets were then bought in Shanghai at a price of
over $4,000. One was transported to Tsingtao.
Meanwhile a compromise was reached between the Japanese
and Chinese exchange brokers in 1932 and the necessity for
using the sets did not arise.
These two sets have never been used.

以下为姜振海（山东籍）的陈述，由我（特务科警探D. S. McKeown）于1935年7月1日下午1时在中央巡捕房录取，由高彦庚（Kao Yan-keng，特务科）巡员翻译。

我叫姜振海，山东籍，21岁，未婚。我住在广东路44号东悦公轮船行（Tung Yoh Kung Shipping Hong）的新办事处。我的职业是掮客，但目前失业。我与东悦公轮船行没有任何关系。我与我的朋友马锦堂（Ma Ching-dong）同住，他是该轮船行的客户，住在行内。
（值得注意的是，通常这些商行除了经营业务外，还为在上海经商的内地客户提供住宿。）伽
继九一八事变（1931年9月18日）之后，青岛钱棉纱交易所的掮客分为两派，一派受日本人控制，另一派受中国人控制。
为了便于上海与青岛之间的市场行情通讯，包括我在内的中国交易所成员决定在青岛和上海安装无线设备。我记得安装工作得到了青岛总商会的批准。
随后在上海购买了两套设备，价格超过4,000美元。其中一套运往青岛。
与此同时，中日交易所掮客于1932年达成妥协，使用这些设备的必要性并未出现。
这两套设备从未被使用过。

Application.
Search Warrant No.7184 issued by Judge Dzien at the request of
the Shanghai Telegraph Office, Ministry of Communications.
    Application is hereby made to the S.S.D.C. for the disposal
of one wooden crate containing a wireless Transmitting &
Receiving Set. which was seized at 11.30 a.m. 1/7/35 from the
Tong Yoch Kong Hong, No.8 The Bund, on the authority of the
abovementioned Warrant.
    Compt. Y.T. Tsih.

        IN THE DISTRICT COURT No.1 - A.M.

Mr. Ru appeared for the S.M.C.
Proceedings :    Mr. Ru :    If Your Honour pleases, in this case acting
on information received from the Shanghai Telegraph Office
(Branch of the Ministry of Communications), that a wireless
transmitting set complete with receiver, was contained in a
wooden crate at premises : Tong Yoch Kong Hong (No.8 The Bund)
Search Warrant P.7184 C3030 was issued by Judge Dzien at the
request of the latter authorities.    On authority of the said
warrant at 11 a.m. on the 1/7/35, detectives from Headquarters
accompanied by a representative of the bureau mentioned, went
to the premises and there they seized the Transmitting &
Receiving Set.    On behalf of the Ministry of Communications,
the Police now make application for the disposal of the seized
property.    The person who is responsible for the set named
Jang Zang Han was questioned, and he made this written statement
(produced).    If the court thinks that the owner or the person
responsible has contravened the regulations governing the use
of such articles, then the property may be disposed of by
confiscation.    On the other hand should the court wish to
deal with the owner, than a remand may be granted.
Decision. A.    The seized exhibits are to be temporarily detained.
Whether or not action should be taken against the
responsible person.    The Police are to investigate
and deal with him in accordance with the law.
                Search warrant handed to Judge.

REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.
The following is the statement of... Chiang Tsung-hai (姜振海)
native of... Shantung ...taken by me... D. S. McKeown (Special Br.)
at... Central ...on the July 1, 1935 ...and interpreted by... Clerk Kao Yau-keng
(Sp. Br.)

My name is Chiang Tsung-hai, native of Shantung, aged 21
and single. I am living in the new office of the Tung Yoeh
Kung (東悅公) Shipping Hong, 44 Canton Road. I am an
exchange broker by profession but am at present unemployed.
I have no connection with the Tung Yoeh Kung Shipping
Hong. I reside with my friend Ma Ching-dong (馬錦堂), who
is a customer of the Shipping Hong and lives on the hong
premises.
(It is of interest to note that as a rule these hongs,
apart from carrying on their business, supply lodging to inland
customers who are conducting business in Shanghai.)
Following the Mukden Incident (September 18, 1931), the
brokers of the Money and Cotton Yarn Exchange at Tsingtao
divided into two parties, one controlled by the Japanese and
the other by the Chinese.
With a view to facilitating communication of news on
markets between Shanghai and Tsingtao, the members of the
Chinese exchange, of whom I was one, decided to instal
wireless apparatus at both Tsingtao and Shanghai. I
recollect that the installation was made with the sanction
of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce at Tsingtao.
Two sets were then bought in Shanghai at a price of
over $4,000. One was transported to Tsingtao.
Meanwhile a compromise was reached between the Japanese
and Chinese exchange brokers in 1932 and the necessity for
using the sets did not arise.
These two sets have never been used.

（值得注意的是，通常此类洋行除经营业务外，还为在上海经商的内地客户提供住宿。）
继“九一八”事变（1931年9月）之后，青岛钱业及棉纱交易所的掮客分为两派，一派受日本人控制，另一派受中国人控制。
为了便于上海与青岛之间的市场行情信息沟通，中国交易所的成员（本人亦为其中之一）决定在青岛和上海两地安装无线电设备。本人记得，该安装事宜已获青岛总商会批准。

Made by D.S. McKeown Forwarded by A. Griffith Capt.

of Police from General Tsai Ching Chun, Commissioner of the

Office of the Municipal Advocate,
July 13, 1935.

Acting Commissioner of Police,

Re Seizure of a Wireless Transmitting and
Receiving Set and charging the responsible
party

Please find attached hereto original copy of a report
relative to the above entitled matter made by Assistant
Municipal Advocate Paul P.Y. Ru.

The Regulations Governing Electrical Messages is a law
which has been regularly and duly enacted and promulgated
by the Nationalist Government. For your information, we
attach hereto a very rough translation of the regulations.
The law in question does not in any way impinge upon or
conflict with the Land Regulations and Bye-laws. Before
giving any advice relative to the search warrant, we
consulted the Secretary General and were advised to
proceed with its execution. Since the execution of the
search warrant, we have had a further conference with the
Secretary-General, and he expressed the opinion that there
was no reason why these regulations should not be enforced
in the Settlement as against persons subject to Chinese
jurisdiction.

Will you kindly cause the application for summons
to be returned to the Court so that the summons may be
issued and served in the regular way.

We are forwarding a copy of this letter, together with
a copy of the attached report, to the Secretary General
for his information. If you have any doubts, we suggest
that you consult him direct.

R.T. Bryan, Jr. (signed),
Municipal Advocate.

Encls: 1/-Report of Assistant Municipal Advocate Ru.
2/- Translation of Regulations Governing Electrical
Messages.

《电信条例》是由国民政府正式制定并颁布的法律。供贵处参考，我们随函附上该条例的粗略译文。该法律在任何方面均未侵犯或与《土地章程》及附则相冲突。在就搜查令提供任何建议之前，我们咨询了秘书长，并被告知执行该搜查令。自执行搜查令以来，我们与秘书长进行了进一步会谈，他表示认为没有理由不对受中国司法管辖的人员在租界内执行这些条例。

我们将此信副本连同所附报告副本一并转送秘书长阅知。如有任何疑问，建议直接向其咨询。

市政检察官。

chambers to discuss the matter. He pointed out
that Article 21 of the Regulations Governing Electrical
Messages as being the law under which

市政检察官办公室。

1935年7月13日。

市政检察官们：

关于：扣押无线收发报机
及起诉责任人。

由上海第一特区地方法院丁赞（Dzien）法官签发的、旨在搜查并扣押无线收发报机的第7184号搜查令，最初经市政检察官批准，随后由特科侦探执行。1935年7月2日，在首席法官丁赞面前召开的公开法庭上，提出了处置扣押物品的申请；警方讯问了一名名为姜宗海（Chiang Tsung Hai）的人，并出示了他的书面供词。

法院裁定如下：

“扣押的证物予以暂时扣留。是否对责任人采取行动，
由警方进行调查并依法处理。”

法院并未指示警方起诉姜宗海，因为起诉权属于工部局董事会。休庭后，署名者被要求前往首席法官办公室讨论此事。他指出，《电信条例》第21条是作为法律依据

page_data.en:
- 2 -

Chiang Tsung Hai should be charged and stated
that the Court will be pleased if the case was
prosecuted.

The undersigned reported the case to
Municipal Advocate who agreed with the Court
and advised C.I. Mason to request the Police
to charge the defendant under the Article
mentioned above.

Application for summons for Chiang Tsung
Hai under Article 21 of the said Regulation was
forwarded to the Court by Central Police Station
and was received and registered by the Court on
July 5, 1935. After the Court had issued the
summons and before the said summons was sent out
by the Court on July 6, at 11:35 a.m. Mr. Wardrop
came and stated to the Judicial Police that the
said application needs some amendment and that the
Court is requested to give the said application
back to the Police for a very short period of
time for the purpose of making corrections. Chief
Judge Dixon, as a special favour to the Police,
gave his consent and the said document was taken
out of the Court with the understanding that it
was only a favour and that the document in question
should be sent back to the Court immediately after
the corrections were made.

Nothing has been heard about the application
since it was taken back by the Police, the Judicial
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

应控告蒋宗海（Chiang Tsung Hai），并指出若能对此案提起公诉，法庭将感到满意。

具名人将此案报告给工部局公诉人，后者同意法庭的意见，并建议警探长梅森（C.I. Mason）要求警方依据上述条款对被告提出控告。

中央巡捕房将根据该条例第21条签发的针对蒋宗海的传票申请书递交至法庭，法庭于1935年7月5日收到并登记。在法庭签发传票后、但在法庭于7月6日上午11时35分发出该传票之前，沃德罗普先生（Mr. Wardrop）前来向司法警察表示，该申请书需要稍作修改，并请求法庭将该申请书交还警方很短一段时间以便进行更正。首席法官狄克逊（Dixon）作为对警方的特别通融，予以同意，并将该文件带出法庭，双方理解这仅是一种通融，且该文件应在更正后立即送回法庭。

自警方取回申请书以来，未闻任何消息，司法

page_data.en:
- 3 -

Police have been requested by the Chief Judge
to get the application back several times but
no result has been obtained. The Court can
not send the summons out as there is no appli-
cation for the same in its files, and no date
can be set for the trial of the case, and as
Chief Judge Dzien said this morning that the
Court does not know what to do with the matter.
The undersigned was told this morning by
the Court re the foregoing and was asked by
the Chief Judge to make a written report to you
with the request that you would take a very
serious view of the matter and take it up with
the Acting Commissioner of Police for a satis-
factory settlement as the Court does not like
to lay its official complaint before the Secretary
General who may not know the facts of this case
as thoroughly as the Municipal Advocate does.

PAUL P.Y. HU
Assistant Municipal Advocate.
page_data.zh:
- 3 -

警察已受首席法官多次要求去追回该申请书，但均无结果。由于法庭档案中没有相应的申请书，法庭无法发出传票，也无法确定案件的审理日期，正如狄克逊（Dzien）首席法官今早所说，法庭不知该如何处理此事。

今早法庭就上述情况告知具名人，并受首席法官委托向您提交书面报告，恳请您高度重视此事，并与代理警务处长交涉以达成满意的解决，因为法庭不愿向秘书长提出正式投诉，秘书长可能不如工部局公诉人那样透彻地了解本案事实。

保罗·P·Y·胡（PAUL P.Y. HU）
助理工部局公诉人

自警方取回申请书以来，未闻任何消息，司法

page_data.en:
- 3 -

Police have been requested by the Chief Judge
to get the application back several times but
no result has been obtained. The Court can
not send the summons out as there is no appli-
cation for the case in its files, and no date
can be set for the trial of the case, and as
Chief Judge Dixon said this morning that the
Court does not know what to do with the matter.

The undersigned was told this morning by
the Court re the foregoing and was asked by
the Chief Judge to make a written report to you
with the request that you would take a very
serious view of the matter and take it up with
the Acting Commissioner of Police for a satis-
factory settlement as the Court does not like
to lay its official complaint before the Secretary
General who may not know the facts of this case
as thoroughly as the Municipal Advocate does.

PAUL P.Y. SU
Assistant Municipal Advocate.
page_data.zh:
- 3 -

今早法庭就上述情况告知具名人，并受首席法官委托向您提交书面报告，恳请您高度重视此事，并与代理警务处长交涉以达成满意的解决，因为法庭不愿向秘书长提出正式投诉，秘书长可能不如工部局公诉人那样透彻地了解本案事实。

Chiang Tsung Hai should be charged and stated
that the Court will be pleased if the case was
prosecuted.

Municipal Advocate who agreed with the Court
and advised C.I. Mason to request the Police
to charge the defendant under the Article
mentioned above.

Application for summons for Chiang Tsung
Hai under Article 21 of the said Regulation was
forwarded to the Court by Central Police Station
and was received and registered by the Court on
July 5, 1935. After the Court had issued the
summons and before the said summons was sent out

gave his consent and the said document was taken
out of the Court with the understanding that it
was only a favour and that the document in question
should be sent back to the Court immediately after
the corrections were made.

The Acting Commissioner of Police:

        REGISTRATION OF RADIO BROADCASTING
              IN THE SETTLEMENT

    I have discussed with the Secretary-General
your report of July 10, 1935.  It is considered that
the factor which must determine the Council's attitude
is not the desirability or otherwise of enforcing
particular Chinese regulations but the desirability
of controlling wireless transmission.  Wireless trans-
mission is universally regarded as a matter which
should be subject to governmental control.  Moreover,
the activities of wireless transmitters within the
Settlement can in fact be hampered or assisted by action
outside the Settlement.

    It is therefore considered that unless any
specific cases arise which you may desire in your
discretion to bring to the attention of the Council
the ordinary practice of acting upon warrants duly
issued by the District Court should be followed.

                          (signed)  G. Godfrey Phillips

Special Branch
July 9, 1935.

Enforcement of Radio Regulations in the Settlement

On June 29, 1935, a Search Warrant, issued by the District Court for the First Special Area in Shanghai, at the instigation of the Shanghai Telegraph Office, Ministry of Communications, for the seizure of a wireless transmitting and receiving set at 8 The Bund, was forwarded to the Special Branch for execution.

The Warrant was passed to the Municipal Advocate for an opinion as to whether or not it should be executed. The Municipal Advocate expressed the opinion that it should be executed providing the interests of foreigners enjoying extraterritorial rights were not involved. The warrant was executed on July 1, and a wireless transmitting and receiving set seized. Application was made at the Shanghai Special District Court for its disposal and it is now detained by the Court pending further action by the Police.

On July 9, another warrant, issued under the same circumstances, was received for execution within the Settlement.

According to our files the question of enforcing radio regulations in the Settlement on behalf of the Chinese authorities has never been settled.

In November and December of 1932 correspondence passed between the Secretary to the Council and the Commissioner of Police regarding a unified system of control by the three authorities but no ruling was given. In a letter dated April 10, 1934, from the Secretary to the Commissioner of Police a request is made for reports to be submitted of any attempts at enforcing radio regulations or functioning by offices of the Bureau of International Telegraphs in the Settlement and French Concession.

December 16, 1932.

The Secretary,
S. M. C.

Reference your letters No.4385, dated the 29th
November and 30th November respectively.

It is an admitted fact that some form of official
control of radio broadcasting is essential. Apart from
the general complaint as to the chaotic state of affairs
in this respect I may state that the Police Broadcasting
has been very seriously interfered with during the year
and in most cases it has been found that the mushroom
growth of irresponsible broadcasting establishments under
no form of control is responsible. There is further the
great danger that uncontrolled radio broadcasting will
present in the near future a serious menace to the peace
and good order of the Settlement as there are many evil
uses to which radio broadcasting can be put.

Control in the Settlement without a similar form of
control in the French Concession and in Chinese Territory
would be useless. There is a limit to the number of
broadcasting stations that can operate in the three areas,
and without co-operation between the three authorities the
allotting of wave lengths would not be possible. It is,
therefore, obvious that a satisfactory system of control
can be introduced only if the three authorities come to a
common agreement on the number of stations to be permitted
in each area and the wave lengths to be allotted to each
station.
page_data.zh:
额外副本

1932年12月16日。

秘书，
上海公共租界工部局。

参照您分别于11月29日和11月30日发出的第4385号信件。

公认的事实是，某种形式的官方无线电广播控制是必不可少的。除了对此方面混乱状况的一般抱怨外，我可以指出，警方的广播在这一年中受到了非常严重的干扰，且在大多数情况下，发现原因是大量不负责任的广播机构在无任何形式控制的情况下如雨后春笋般涌现。此外，不受控制的无线电广播在不久的将来会对租界的和平与良好秩序构成严重威胁，因为无线电广播可能被用于许多有害用途。

如果法租界和中国领土没有类似形式的控制，仅在租界内进行控制将是徒劳的。在这三个区域能运营的广播电台数量有限，如果没有三方当局的合作，波长分配将无法实现。因此，显而易见，只有当三方当局就每个区域允许设立的电台数量以及分配给每个电台的波长达成共同协议时，才能引入令人满意的控制系统。

page_data.en:
-- 2 --

The new Chinese regulations, if they were applied in
the Settlement, would effect Chinese owned stations only
and Foreign owned stations could operate without control.
The application of these regulations would not therefore
solve the difficulty.

It would therefore appear necessary that a general
working agreement be come to between the authorities of the
three areas, and that suitable licensing byelaws be intro-
duced in accordance with such agreement which could be
enforced in the Settlement in the case of all radio broad-
casting stations, whether Foreign or Chinese owned.

If suitable byelaws are introduced, it would not be
difficult for the Police to enforce them.

(signed) F. W. Gerrard.

Commissioner of Police.
page_data.zh:
-- 2 --

新的中国法规如果在租界内实施，将仅影响华人拥有的电台，而外国人拥有的电台则可以在不受控制的情况下运营。因此，实施这些法规并不能解决困难。

因此，似乎有必要由这三个区域的当局达成一项总体工作协议，并根据该协议引入适当的许可附例，以便在租界内对所有无线电广播电台（无论是外国人还是华人拥有）强制执行。

如果引入适当的附例，警方执行起来并不困难。

（签名） F. W. Gerrard.

警务处总监。

1932年11月29日。

警务处总监：

法国总领事馆的雅克·科伊法尔先生（Mr. Jacques Coiffard）昨天拜访了我，并向我展示了国民政府的新无线电法规，该法规刊登在昨天的报纸上。这些法规规定对上海的无线电台及其设备进行许可和检查，并通过罚款和没收手段强制执行。

法国总领事和法国市政当局渴望规范法租界内这些电台的活动，他们非常希望获得工部局的合作，如果可能的话，还希望获得中国当局的合作。就中国当局的合作而言，科伊法尔先生建议，可以为这三个市政区各自安排不同的波长。

法国当局已经在努力对这些电台进行许可，但由于目前尚不确定在没有租界合作的情况下的执行手段，他们试图通过临时许可证来做到这一点。

工部局不太可能允许在租界内通过没收或其他方式检查和执行新规则。然而，我非常希望听取您对新法规的看法，以及在工部局与法国当局合作的方案下，由工部局进行检查和执行其中部分规定的可能性的问题。

British Consulate-General,
Shanghai.
October 21, 1935.

Dear Bourne,

The Consul-General has received a letter from the
Telegraph Administration alleging that a British subject
named Mc.Lellan residing at 119, Baikal Road is
operating a wireless transmitting set. Translation
of the letter is enclosed herewith.

It is true that there are no regulations binding
on British subjects to prevent the use of such sets
but under a resolution passed at the Washington
Conference the establishment of radio stations in China
by foreigners is restricted and we have always discouraged
the setting up of any station by British subjects without
the consent of the Chinese Authorities.

The Consul-General would be much obliged if the
Shanghai Municipal Police could supply him with any
information regarding McLellan and his wireless
activities.

Yours sincerely,

I.W.O. Davidson.

Major K.M. Bourne, M.C.,
Acting Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council,
Shanghai.

Certified true copy.

A.G.L. Richard....

英国驻上海总领事馆，
上海。
1935年10月21日。

亲爱的伯恩（Bourne）：

总领事收到电政管理局的一封信，指控一名居住在贝加尔路119号、名为麦克莱伦（Mc.Lellan）的英国臣民正在操作一部无线发射装置。随函附上该信的译文。

诚然，并无约束英国臣民禁止使用此类装置的规章，但根据华盛顿会议通过的一项决议，外国人在中国设立电台受到限制，且我们一直不鼓励英国臣民在未获中国政府同意的情况下设立任何电台。

如上海公共租界工部局警务处能提供有关麦克莱伦及其无线电活动的任何信息，总领事将不胜感激。

此致

敬礼

I.W.O. 戴维森（Davidson）

Translation of letter from the Ministry of Communications
Telegraph Administration, Shanghai, to H.B.M. Consul-
General, Shanghai.
------------------

October 4th, 1935.

Sir,

This Administration has recently received a
secret report to the following effect :-

"In the house at No. 119 Baikal Road, Shanghai,
there is a privately established wireless station
which transmits and receives messages in contravention
of the law".

The Shanghai First Special District Court was
immediately requested to investigate and take action in
accordance with law. It has now been discovered that the
occupier of the above house is a British subject, and
action should be taken with the assistance of the British
Consulate. The establishment of a private wireless station
is strictly prohibited by the laws and orders of China,
and should be punished by law.

I am now sending Mr. Hsu Tsung-I, an official of this
Administration, to call on you with this letter, and explain
everything to you verbally. I shall be very grateful if
you will give approval to sending an official in the
company of Mr. Hsu to go to the above address and make a
search, in order to help the Administration of telegraph
matters.

I have long been aware that your country has always
respected the authority of the law, and, moreover, that a
guiding principle with you is the sincere cultivation of
friendly international relations and therefore your assis-
tance will of course be given.

I request that you will note this matter and take
action, and favour me with a reply.

I avail, etc.
(Sd) Fan K'o-yung,
Minister.

Certified true
copy.
A.H.L. Richards

交通部上海电政管理局致英国驻上海总领事的信函译文。
------------------

1935年10月4日。

先生：

本局近日收到一份密报，内容如下：

“上海贝加尔路119号住宅内，设有一私建无线电台，违法收发报文”。

当即请求上海第一特区地方法院依法调查并采取行动。现已查明，上述房屋的居住者为一名英国臣民，故应在英国领事馆的协助下采取行动。中国法令严禁设立私人无线电台，违者应依法惩处。

现派本局官员许宗毅（Hsu Tsung-I）持此函拜会阁下，并向阁下口头说明一切。如蒙批准派员陪同许先生前往上述地址进行搜查，以协助电政管理，本人将不胜感激。

本人久知贵国一向尊重法律权威，且贵国以真诚培养国际友好关系为指导原则，因此必能给予协助。

请阁下对此事予以关注并采取行动，并赐复为荷。

此致

敬礼
（签名）范可庸（Fan K'o-yung），
局长。

经核证
无误副本。
A.H.L. 理查兹（Richards）

Special Branch, October 22, 1935.

Suspected installation of a radio set at 119 Baikal Road.

In connection with the suspected installation of an unauthorised
transmitting set at 119 Baikal Road, I have to report that Mr. C.
A. McLellan, the occupant of the premises and an employee of the
J. M. C. , during a conversation with an acquaintance admitted that
he had a combined transmitting and receiving set installed in his
house, and that this set was specially imported from America for him
by the directors of Radio Station XMHA. He added that though he had
never used the set for transmitting purposes, he had frequently
loaned it to Radio Station XMHA.

Radio Station XMHA is sponsored by the Radio Engineering Co.,
445 Race Course Road. Dr. W. H. Downs, an American dental surgeon,
is said to possess the major financial interest in the venture.

Regarding the incident on October 6, when an agent of the
Shanghai Telegraph Administration was arrested at the request of
Mr. McLellan for loitering outside his house, but later released,
Mr. McLellan mentioned that he had reported the matter to the
British Consulate-General.

Mr. McLellan dismissed his two servants shortly after this
incident.

Certified True Copy.
JMcGivens

特别支部，1935年10月22日。

涉嫌在贝加尔路119号安装无线电装置。

关于涉嫌在贝加尔路119号安装未经授权的发射装置一事，兹报告如下：该处住户、工部局雇员 C.A. 麦克莱伦（C. A. McLellan）先生在与熟人交谈时承认，他在家中安装了一部收发两用机，且该装置是由 XMHA 电台的主管人员特地从美国为他进口的。他补充说，虽然他从未将该装置用于发射目的，但他经常将其借给 XMHA 电台使用。

XMHA 电台由跑马厅路445号的无线电工程公司（Radio Engineering Co.）赞助。据悉，美国牙科医生 W.H. 唐斯（W. H. Downs）博士在该企业中拥有主要财务权益。

关于10月6日发生的事件，当时应麦克莱伦先生的要求，逮捕了一名在其屋外徘徊的电政管理局特工，但随后将其释放。麦克莱伦先生提到，他已将此事报告给英国总领事馆。

在此事件发生后不久，麦克莱伦先生解雇了他的两名仆人。

经核证无误副本。
J McGivens
